permits.summary: County development control and building-plan pathways for a new build, alteration or change of use.

items.title: Development permission / land-use review
items.when: Likely applicable to building work or a material change of use.
items.source: Kenya Law — Physical and Land Use Planning Act

items.title: Building and structural permits
items.when: Likely applicable before construction; scope depends on the proposal.
items.source: Nairobi Planning and Development Management System

items.title: Building occupation certificate
items.when: Likely applicable before opening an approved new or altered building.
items.source: Nairobi Planning and Development Management System

permits.summary: Planning, building regulations and operational fire-safety pathways for public worship premises.

items.title: Planning permission / change of use
items.when: Likely applicable where the proposal changes use or includes development; public worship is listed under use class F1(f).
items.source: Planning Portal — Use Classes

items.title: Building regulations approval
items.when: Likely applicable to new building work and many material alterations or changes of use.
items.source: Planning Portal — change-of-use guidance

items.title: Fire risk assessment and precautions
items.when: Likely applicable while operating a place of assembly; duties depend on premises and management.
items.source: GOV.UK — Fire safety risk assessment for assembly premises

permits.summary: City-specific zoning, construction and place-of-assembly pathways for houses of worship.

items.title: Zoning and building filing
items.when: Likely applicable to a new building, alteration or change in lawful use.
items.source: NYC Buildings — PACO project requirements

items.title: Place of Assembly Certificate of Operation
items.when: NYC states this is required at specified indoor/outdoor gathering thresholds; verify current occupancy and scope.
items.source: NYC Buildings — Place of Assembly Certificate of Operation

items.title: Annual fire inspection / permit pathway
items.when: Likely applicable after a PACO is issued; confirm current FDNY requirements.
items.source: NYC Buildings — Place of Assembly Certificate of Operation

permits.summary: Development-consent pathway for a new or adapted place of public worship, subject to local planning controls.

items.title: Development application
items.when: The NSW guidance identifies new builds, alterations and conversion/adaptation as proposals requiring a development application.
items.source: NSW Planning — places of public worship guidance

items.title: Local environmental and development-control review
items.when: Likely applicable through the development assessment against local and state planning controls.
items.source: NSW Planning — places of public worship guidance

funding.summary: Separate project donations, operating income and any income-generating activity; obtain local tax and legal advice.

items.title: Restricted project campaign
items.when: Use a documented purpose, approvals, signatories, reporting cadence and treatment of surplus.
items.source: Uganda Revenue Authority — taxation of religious institutions

items.title: Religious-organization exemption review
items.when: Exemption and treatment differ by country and activity; the cited Uganda guidance says a letter of exemption is required there.
items.source: Uganda Revenue Authority — taxation of religious institutions

items.title: Land or asset endowment structure
items.when: Specialist legal, tax, governance and Shariah review required before representing an arrangement as waqf.
items.authority: Local counsel, trustees and qualified Shariah reviewers
items.source: Repository waqf governance requirements

funding.summary: Charity funds, restricted purposes and permanent endowment are governed through the charity’s documents and Charity Commission framework.

items.title: General or restricted fundraising campaign
items.when: Trustees should document purpose, controls, reporting and how funds further the charity’s objects.
items.source: Charity Commission — managing money, assets and property

items.title: Permanent-endowment assessment
items.when: Potentially relevant where donated assets must be retained rather than spent; governing documents determine treatment.
items.source: Charity Commission — permanent endowment rules

funding.summary: Federal tax-exempt and contribution rules are only one layer; state charity, fundraising and property rules still require review.

items.title: Religious-organization tax status review
items.when: Potentially relevant to entity setup and donor representations; verify recognition and state requirements.
items.source: IRS — Churches and religious organizations

items.title: Contribution substantiation workflow
items.when: Likely relevant when acknowledging donations or representing deductibility.
items.source: IRS Publication 526 — Charitable Contributions

items.title: Endowment or reserve policy
items.when: Board, legal, investment and qualified Shariah review required; do not assume a generic endowment is a waqf.
items.source: IRS Publication 557 — Tax-Exempt Status

funding.summary: ACNC charity obligations combine with state or territory fundraising regulation.

items.title: Charity registration and subtype review
items.when: Potentially relevant before making charity-status representations.
items.source: ACNC — who can apply

items.title: Fundraising-law review
items.when: Likely applicable in each state or territory where funds are raised.
items.source: ACNC — charity fundraising and the public

items.title: Basic Religious Charity assessment
items.when: Only relevant where all ACNC criteria are met; do not assume the category applies.
items.source: ACNC — Basic Religious Charities
